Players Committee card image of [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png] as of commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata” (20 April 2022).
